body.purpose: Placement advice, blueprint cards, and viva questions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Wine velvet CTA button with smooth hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9f1239; color: #f8fafc; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #881337; }

components.name: Obsidian Card
components.description: Frosted obsidian glass panel with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-card-obsidian { background: #11131c; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px; } .ds-card-title { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 14px; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-metric { color: #f8fafc; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Pathfinder 2.0 embodies an ultra-luxury, dark-mode cybersecurity and career intelligence aesthetic.

rules.name: The Protected Canvas Rule
rules.body: The global background (#0a0b10), the OLED avatar viewport (#000000), LampLogin, and 3D WebGL motion are protected anchors.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by border contrast and background tone shifts, never by blurry colored shadows.

dos: Do preserve the OLED True Black (#000000) container around the AI Avatar Canvas.
Do preserve the LampLogin page styling, shaders, and animations.
Do preserve the 3D WebGL background motion and shader loops.
donts: Don't modify the AI voice agent face or avatar dimensions.
Don't alter the main dashboard dark background (#0a0b10).
Don't introduce bright white card backgrounds or light mode themes.
